validation.applyResult: Confirmed: Synapse selected Fixed Fan Speed at 3800 RPM and emitted paired manual-state and fan-target writes.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed: the exact production thermal query returned manual/fixed state and three settled RPM samples reached 3700/3600, 3700/3600, and 3700/3700 for the 3800 RPM target.
validation.restorationResult: Confirmed: separate graceful captures restored both thermal channels from fixed 3800 RPM and fixed 5000 RPM to Automatic.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed: exact typed and production readback returned Balanced/Automatic; visible Synapse returned to Auto (Default).

sanitizedEvidence.summary: Fixed mode selected at 18.348566 and 18.359144 seconds; the visible saved target was 3800 RPM.
The LOW endpoint displayed 2000 RPM and emitted the exact minimum targets at 18.212075 and 18.227457 seconds.
The HIGH endpoint displayed 5000 RPM and emitted the exact maximum targets at 17.429671 and 17.439198 seconds.
Fixed 3800 RPM was restored to Automatic in a separate graceful capture.
Fixed 5000 RPM was restored to Automatic in a separate graceful capture.

The exact two-channel production query distinguished manual/fixed state from restored Balanced/Automatic. Settled RPM was 1900/1900 three times at the 2000 target and 4900/4900 three times at the 5000 target.

productionAdmission.identityScope: RZ09-0528, BIOS 2.02, USB 1532:02C6, HID usage 0001:0002, 91-byte feature reports

limitations: Manual Fan Curve was not exercised and remains unadmitted.
The protocol reads fixed and maximum targets back as the same manual fan state; RPM queries provide the independent physical response.
Two broad fixed-state discriminator attempts and two RPM samples failed under Synapse polling contention; they were not reclassified as successful evidence.
The exact maximum is 5000 RPM and must not inherit the PID 02E0 maximum of 5400 RPM.
CPU Voltage Optimizer was not changed.
Keyboard lighting remains off at the operator's request.
Raw PCAPs and unique device identifiers remain private and uncommitted.
notes: All five successful sessions targeted the visually reverified USBPcap2 device address 3 and ended through the sentinel-driven graceful-stop path.
Final visible and typed state was Plugged In, Balanced, Auto (Default).
